content.title: What is EKORU?
content.paragraph1-1: is much more than an app: it's a new way of approaching consumption. A platform that allows you to
content.paragraph1Highlight: buy, sell, trade, repair, and recycle
content.paragraph1-2: consciously, practically, and enjoyably. We believe that what you already have matters, that what others let go can bloom again, and that every daily decision can contribute to a healthier planet and a more aware community.
content.paragraph2-1: Here you don't just connect with objects,
content.paragraph2-3: . And you don't just make an impact,
